verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an official hosted MCP server that it says can connect "any AI client" with a single command, plus plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other harnesses. Memories are scoped by user_id, so different tools can read and write the same per-user memory store. missing for 10: no explicit ChatGPT (or Claude desktop/chat app) integration named, no documentation or hands-on evidence of one user's memory actually being shared across multiple assistants, no independent corroboration of the MCP or plugin setup.
